text:
devon: quick ping — PR #54799 needs runtime + infra + security eyes for a short canary tomorrow morning. touches: runtime kv-cache fallback + adds optional KMS flag. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/54799 :wave:
neha-platform: can you summarize blast radius and proposed canary window? also who will own rollback?
devon: sure — 2 files, ~40 LOC. default behavior unchanged (flag defaults to off). canary: 30m lane on prod-candidate, 10% traffic. rollback: revert the merge + scale replicas to previous replicaCount; I can own rollback if needed.
sam-runtime: can you paste perf/ci numbers? want to make sure no alloc/regression on hot path. :eyes:
devon: CI perf run (short):
```
run: make perf-test
median_latency_tokens: 4.2ms -> 4.3ms (+2.4%)
99p_tail: 52ms -> 54ms (+3.8%)
```
looks within noise; added unit test for kv fallback.
jordan-infra: routing note — this touches KMS wiring. need infra-oncall to sign off on key usage and network egress. cc @infra-oncall. Also confirm no new IAM roles.
lisa-security: quick checks: which KMS key alias, and where are audit logs stored? need to confirm no plaintext key material leaves node.
devon: KMS alias: alias/redwood/canary-test, audits go to s3://redwood-audit-logs/kms/. no new IAM roles; uses existing node role. commands used in deploy:
```
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-service KMS_ALIAS=alias/redwood/canary-test
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-service
```
ops-bot: Scheduled canary window at 2024-02-12T09:00Z for 30m on prod-candidate (created by neha-platform).
neha-platform: I can own the canary run and monitoring. sam-runtime and lisa-security — can you both +1 so I can merge and schedule?
sam-runtime: will review logs and tracing after work — +1 provisional, will follow up if anything shows up. :thumbsup:
lisa-security: +1 pending I can run a quick key audit pre-merge. assign to me for post-deploy verification.
devon: thanks — i'll wait for lisa to confirm audit then merge. plan: merge today, canary tomorrow 09:00Z. ping me if you want a different window.
